def f(I):
    g=[r[:] for r in I]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter, defaultdict
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    bycol=defaultdict(list)
    for i,row in enumerate(g):
        for j,x in enumerate(row):
            if x!=bg: bycol[x].append((i,j))
    best=None; bw=None
    for col,cs in bycol.items():
        rs=[r for r,_ in cs]; ccs=[c for _,c in cs]
        h=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; w=max(ccs)-min(ccs)+1
        area=h*w
        solid = len(cs)==h*w and 2*area<=H*W
        if (solid or True) and not (best and (not solid)): best=(area,col); bw=col
        elif solid and (not best or area>=best[0]): best=(area,col); bw=col
    # choose largest solid rectangle color as pivot
    cw=next(c for c in bycol if all(len(bycol[c])==h*(w))) # placeholder

    cand=[]

        rs=[r for r,_ in cs]; ccs=[c for _,c in cs]
        h=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; w=max(ccs)-min(ccs)+1
        if len(cs)==h*w: cand.append((len(cs),col,(min(rs)+max(rs))/2,(min(ccs)+max(ccs))/2))
    best=max(cand,key=lambda t:t[0])
